title: Proposed C6 session request
description: Structural proposal only; no adapter, authentication, consent gesture, freshness, replay or spending enforcement is proved. The four wire names are INVENTED in BRIEF-C6-RELAY. The canonical UTC timestamp grammar, lowercase UUIDv4 nonce, nonempty string requirements and SDP bound are INVENTED conventions for C review. Request credentials are separate from this body.

sdp_offer.description: INVENTED limit: at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes. JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode characters, not encoded bytes, and is only a necessary structural bound. A separate UTF-8 byte-length check is required before provider creation. This schema does not parse or authorize SDP.

user.description: Existing exact named-user ids; neither this enum nor matching opt_in.user authenticates a caller.

nonce.description: INVENTED wire convention: lowercase canonical UUIDv4. Echo matching is separate from trustworthy replay rejection.

utcTimestamp.description: INVENTED fixed UTC wire grammar YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ. The pattern is lexical; a real calendar-validity check is required because format may be annotation-only. It does not establish freshness, clock truth or a consent gesture.

screen_version.description: INVENTED strict string shape only. The reviewed version allowlist is a separate C/D prerequisite; this schema does not approve any version.

wording.description: INVENTED strict string shape only. Must equal the actual reviewed wording for screen_version at admission; nonempty text is not a supported disclosure or evidence of agreement.
